title: antirrhinum latifolium subsp. intermedium
intro: Antirrhinum latifolium subsp. intermedium, commonly known as the Intermediate Snapdragon, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Antirrhinum latifolium subsp. intermedium include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as coughs and colds, and its antispasmodic properties, which can help to reduce muscle spasms and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
